scope: Datasets admissible for the Omics2PK five-objective validation (H1-H5). A published article is not by itself an exploitable dataset.

access_policy.rule: Only data effectively retrievable without an authorization request or a collaboration agreement may enter a confirmatory analysis.
access_policy.open_public: Retrievable by URL with no account. Admissible for confirmatory analysis.
access_policy.public_registered: Retrievable by anyone who creates an account and accepts data-use terms; no committee reviews the request. Admissible only if the user rules it admissible; flagged for ruling.
access_policy.author_request: Requires contacting an author. NOT admissible in this phase.
access_policy.governed_application: Requires an ethics/registry committee decision. NOT admissible in this phase.
access_policy.unavailable: No individual-level data released in any form.
forbidden_practices: reconstructing individual rows from published means, figures or ranges
presenting simulated values as biological results
merging unrelated cohorts into a pseudo-subject
counting two drugs measured in the same donors as two independent biological cohorts

status_definitions.ACQUIRED: Source bytes in hand with a recorded SHA-256; identity/endpoint qualification not yet asserted.
status_definitions.QUALIFIED: Acquired AND the biological unit, endpoint, matrix, timing and omics identity have been checked against a named objective.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Some qualification requirements met; a named requirement is still open.
status_definitions.ABSTAIN: Cannot be used in this phase; reason recorded.

endpoint_classes.pk_clinical: A pharmacokinetic observation in a treated human (concentration, AUC, CL/F).
endpoint_classes.functional_in_vitro: An enzyme activity or intrinsic clearance measured in tissue/microsomes. NOT human PK.
endpoint_classes.pd_cell_line: A cell-line drug-response endpoint. Neither PK nor human PD.
endpoint_classes.biomarker_only: Molecular ratios with a genotype reference but no drug exposure measurement.

verification_legend.verified_this_session: true = the stated provenance facts were checked on 2026-11-07 by retrieving the source and/or recomputing the checksum. false = inherited from a prior repository document and NOT re-verified here.

datasets.label: ARIANA metoprolol n=47
datasets.citation: Saromba JA, Kurt B, Antwerpen A, Rex K, Giacin A, Bornemann J, Aygar K, Mertens M, Mueller-Wieland D, Dahl E, Marx N, Kahles F, Wozniak J, Neiss J, Krzoska D, Stingl JC, Mueller JP, Just KS. Front Pharmacol. 2026 May 29;17:1812007.
datasets.data_availability_statement: Original data were uploaded to a repository accessible under the following link: https://github.com/katjajust/Solandine-Metoprolol-Correlations
datasets.sampling_time: fasting pre-dose trough; absolute clock time and time since last dose NOT documented in the source

omics_layers.identification_quality: solanidine and 4-OH-solanidine quantified; SSDA semi-quantitative, no authentic analytical standard

datasets.genotypes: CYP2D6 SNP panel with copy number; activity score derived (source supplementary S2)
datasets.comedication: CYP2D6 substrate/inhibitor list recorded (source supplementary S3)
datasets.dose_regimen: metoprolol twice daily in equal doses; 23 patients at 95 mg/day and 24 at 190 mg/day
datasets.formulation: NOT documented in the source. Succinate extended-release inferred from the 47.5/95/190 mg German strengths; immediate-release tartrate retained as a sensitivity analysis. Formulation must not be chosen on observed MAE.
datasets.verification_method: Downloaded from the repository named in the data availability statement; SHA-256 recomputed and found identical to the file already used in the local ARIANA analysis.
caveats: One concentration per patient. MAP-Bayesian estimation conditioned on that concentration and then predicting it is circular (measured optimism factor 3.6) and is excluded by construction.
An NLME likelihood is not identifiable from a single observation per subject.
The OH-metoprolol/metoprolol metabolic ratio is present in the source but shares its denominator with the target concentration. It may be used ONLY as a validation target, never as a predictor.

The source publication's own primary result is the correlation between solanidine-derived and metoprolol-derived metabolic ratios. Reproducing it is a positive control on the implementation, NOT a new finding of this project.
Single centre, single laboratory, single assay.

datasets.label: Mueller phenotyping cocktail n=20
datasets.citation: Mueller JP, Saromba J, Ziegler P, Tremmel R, Rengelshausen J, Schaeffeler E, Just KS, Schwab M, Kraus T, Stingl JC. Clin Pharmacol Ther. 2024 Feb;115(2):309-317.
datasets.design: phenotyping cocktail in healthy volunteers; 12.5 mg oral metoprolol; 15 plasma sampling points over 24 h; solanidine, 4-OH-solanidine and SSDA by LC-MS; all participants CYP2D6 genotyped

endpoint.name: AUC metabolic ratio alpha-OH-metoprolol/metoprolol and solanidine-derived ratios

datasets.abstain_reason: No individual-level data released. Europe PMC core record reports hasData=N, hasSuppl=N, no PMCID; the publisher page returns HTTP 403. Published aggregate values must not be converted into reconstructed individual rows.
datasets.verification_method: Europe PMC REST core record for DOI 10.1002/cpt.3106 retrieved and inspected; publisher full text attempted and refused.
datasets.consequence: This was the designated independent biological and temporal validation for the solanidine module (intra-individual stability, effect of sampling time). Its loss means no public dataset can currently test within-subject temporal stability of the solanidine ratios.

datasets.label: Wollmann TDM cohort n=839
datasets.citation: Wollmann BM, Storset E, Kringen MK, Molden E, Smith RL. Eur J Clin Pharmacol. 2023;79(4):523-531.
datasets.design: retrospective routine TDM serum samples, Diakonhjemmet Hospital Oslo, 2019-2022; solanidine plus seven metabolites (M402, M412, M414, M416, M432, M440, M444=SSDA); CYP2D6 panel *3/*4/*6/*9/*10/*41/*5 with copy number

endpoint.name: metabolite-to-solanidine ratios versus CYP2D6 genotype group

datasets.abstain_reason: Data availability statement: 'The data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author, BMW, upon reasonable request.' No repository, accession or URL.
datasets.verification_method: PMC full text retrieved; data availability statement and supplementary file list inspected.
datasets.note: Even if obtained, no drug exposure is measured, so this cohort could serve objective H5 (biological validity of the marker) but never H1 (incremental PK prediction).

datasets.label: Kiiski Finnish volunteers n=314 analysed
datasets.citation: Kiiski JI, Neuvonen M, Kurkela M, Hirvensalo P, Haemaelaeinen K, Tarkiainen EK, Sistonen J, Korhonen M, Khan S, Orpana A, Filppula AM, Lehtonen M, Niemi M. Hum Genomics. 2024;18:11.
datasets.design: healthy Finnish volunteers, overnight-fasting plasma, non-targeted metabolomics, CYP2D6 genotype reference, in vitro work and GWAS

endpoint.name: solanidine and metabolite levels versus CYP2D6 genotype

datasets.abstain_reason: Available from the corresponding author on reasonable request, and further limited by informed consent and the EU GDPR. No repository or accession.
datasets.verification_method: PMC full text retrieved; data availability statement inspected.

datasets.label: Sage Bionetworks Human Liver Cohort
datasets.citation: Schadt EE et al. PLoS Biol. 2008 (PMID 18462017); Yang X et al. Genome Res. 2010, doi 10.1101/gr.103341.109.
datasets.access_note: Open to anyone who registers a Synapse account and accepts the data-use terms. No committee reviews the request, which distinguishes it from a governed application. REQUIRES A USER RULING on admissibility under the strict public-only rule.
datasets.matrix: liver tissue and human liver microsomes

omics_layers.analytes: Agilent microarray, 40638 probes including CYP1A2/2A6/2B6/2C8/2C9/2C19/2D6/2E1/3A4/3A5, POR, transporters
omics_layers.identification_quality: platform probe annotation only; not orthogonally confirmed by qPCR or protein

omics_layers.analytes: 449699 SNP rows; only rs776746 (CYP3A5) and rs1799853 (CYP2C9) usable pharmacogenetically
omics_layers.identification_quality: array calls, reference allele orientation not independently confirmed

endpoint.name: CYP substrate turnover activity in human liver microsomes

datasets.h1_functional_analogue_note: Incremental value of CYP transcript over a clinical baseline is measurable here, but on microsomal enzyme activity. It is the functional analogue of H1 and must never be reported as H1, which is defined on clinical pharmacokinetics.
datasets.qualified_for: H3/H4/H5 directly, plus the functional analogue of H1, on an in vitro endpoint only. It can never satisfy the H1 criterion, which is stated on clinical PK.
datasets.verification_method: All four local archive SHA-256 values recomputed on 2026-11-07 and found identical to those recorded in docs/HLC_ORIGINAL_400_LIVER_CYP_RNA_GENOTYPE_RESULTS_20261018.md.
caveats: No matched quantitative CYP protein, so the RNA -> protein -> activity chain cannot be completed in this cohort.
Body weight is missing for most donors and must not be imputed as if observed.
Source terms prohibit redistribution and any attempt to identify donors; only aggregates may be committed.
Absolute MAE magnitudes are in source assay units and should be reported as within-endpoint relative changes.

datasets.label: EPA liver donor transcript and CYP activity panel n=100
datasets.open_requirement: Source URL, accession and SHA-256 were not re-verified in this session. The registry must not assert provenance that was not checked.

datasets.label: Wegler liver donors n=15
datasets.access_note: Published supplement (Data S1/S2) is the stated source of donor-level values.

omics_layers.analytes: liver CYP and transporter protein quantities

endpoint.name: measured in vitro hepatic intrinsic clearance for five drugs

datasets.open_requirement: Donor-level table extraction, units and SHA-256 not re-verified in this session.
caveats: 15 donors cannot support high-dimensional selection; parsimony budgets must stay very small.
No measured RNA, so no transcript-to-protein comparison inside this cohort.

datasets.label: Latham / TKI imatinib and tucatinib donor panel

endpoint.name: CYP protein, activity and intrinsic clearance for imatinib and tucatinib

datasets.open_requirement: Donor identity overlap with other hepatic panels must be resolved before any cross-drug transfer claim.
caveats: Two drugs measured in the same donors are ONE biological cohort, not two independent replications.

datasets.label: Jarmusch CYP3A midazolam metabolomics

omics_layers.identification_quality: GNPS library annotation; a GNPS name is NOT a standard-confirmed structure

datasets.open_requirement: Subject crosswalk between the GNPS feature table and the clinical PK/PGx table, plus plasma-versus-urine and day-1-versus-day-9 separation, must be established before any H1 claim.
datasets.verification_method: Local archive SHA-256 computed on 2026-11-07; member list inspected (graphml, clusterinfo, DB_result, qiime2 metadata and table).
caveats: Low sample size with very high feature dimension makes this the designated hard-selection stress test, not a primary H1 cohort.

datasets.label: Rotroff metformin pharmacometabolomics n=33
datasets.open_requirement: Pre-dose versus post-dose feature separation and the subject key were not re-verified in this session.
caveats: Metformin is not a CYP substrate; it tests the method, not the CYP2D6 mechanism.

datasets.label: NCI-60 cell lines
datasets.qualified_for: A dimension/selection stress test on a non-PK endpoint only.
caveats: A cell-line response is neither human PK nor human PD. It can never satisfy H1.

datasets.label: Estonian Biobank pharmacokinetic recall study n=114
datasets.abstain_reason: Access requires an application under the Estonian Human Genes Research Act. Explicitly excluded by the current mission's public-only constraint.
datasets.verification_method: Access conditions read from the source publication during the previous phase and re-classified against the current access policy on 2026-11-07.
datasets.note: Recorded because it was the strongest acquisition target identified previously; it is retired for this phase, not forgotten. It is the only identified dataset that would unlock a real MAP-Bayesian comparison with several metoprolol concentrations per subject.

datasets.label: Geriatric cohort n=88 (source of the delta activity score coefficient)
datasets.abstain_reason: Available on reasonable request from the corresponding author.
datasets.note: This cohort supplied the delta activity score of -0.54 used as a fixed module coefficient in the ARIANA mechanistic model. The coefficient is therefore transferred from a cohort whose rows cannot be inspected here.

datasets.label: PK-DB pharmacokinetics database
datasets.abstain_reason: Service offline: no response from pk-db.com, develop.pk-db.com or the v1 API, and no data repository published on GitHub.
datasets.note: Verified unreachable during the previous phase.

datasets.label: Previously prioritised acquisition queue, retired by the public-only rule
datasets.abstain_reason: Every item in the repository's former P0/P1 external acquisition queue depends on an author request or a governance decision, which the current phase forbids.
members: Zhang n=100 / Ohtsuki n=17 hepatic RNA-protein-activity
datasets.verification_method: docs/EXTERNAL_DATA_ACQUISITION_MATRIX_20261024.md read and each entry's minimum next source classified against the access policy.
datasets.consequence: The project's remaining open questions cannot be answered by acquisition in this phase. They must be answered with data already in hand, or abstained from.

no_public_replication_cohort_for_the_sol.statement: No publicly available dataset pairs solanidine-derived metabolic ratios with an individual drug exposure measurement other than ARIANA itself.
no_public_replication_cohort_for_the_sol.consequence: The H1 replication criterion cannot be met for the CYP2D6/solanidine axis with public data. Replication must therefore be sought on a different biological axis and on a functional endpoint, which is a weaker form of evidence and must be labelled as such.

phase1_findings.endpoint_class_separation: Only ariana_metoprolol_47, jarmusch_midazolam and rotroff_metformin_33 carry a clinical PK endpoint. HLC, EPA, Wegler and the TKI panel carry functional in vitro endpoints. NCI-60 carries a cell-line endpoint. These must never be pooled into a common effect estimate.
